item.title: Initial returns on IT and data sales tax falling short of estimates, as state grapples with budget
item.description: A controversial sales tax on IT services that was approved last year is not filling state coffers as expected. item.description: UPPER MARLBORO, Md. — Twenty-eight dogs face euthanasia at the Prince George’s County Animal Shelter due to severe overcrowding, with a deadline for commitments by noon and pickups by 6 p.m. on March 17, 2026.
